author: Mark Atwood
text:
Filing as human alongside JMAP-jfia.19 / .26 — direct parallel: BackendCallFn type alias hardcodes Fn(Arc<B>, String, Value, C) -> HandlerFuture. Adding a 5th param (deadline, trace context, etc.) breaks all ClosureHandler call sites.

Mitigation options: (a) replace with a CallContext struct, (b) document closure as 4-arg and add new variants for future shapes. Defer to major-bump.
